entities.name: Paola Elisabetta Cerioli

entities.summary: Paola Elisabetta Cerioli, born Costanza Cerioli, was an Italian Roman Catholic widow and the founder of both the Institute of Sisters of the Holy Family and the congregation of the Family of Bergamo.
